entries.scope: isolated exact-GLB offline visual review; not actual story-scene approval

findings.finding: The beard/chin underside forms a dark outward lip above a separate smooth neck. The neck-to-shirt edge has exposed mismatched skin/gray collar patches, so the head reads as grafted rather than continuous human anatomy.
findings.correction: Rebuild or blend the head/neck topology and skin texture through the shirt opening; remove the horizontal chin-base shelf and close every collar-side seam. Review both side profiles and an elevated player view.

findings.finding: The candidate has the broad cues of the photographic subject, but the smooth pale face, squared dark chin band and frontal hair/temple distribution are not yet a close, independently defensible match. The only photographic source is one small three-quarter seated thumbnail; it does not establish the candidate front/profile.
findings.correction: Obtain and actually view closer official interview frames for face front, both three-quarters/profile and natural hair/beard. Refine the face/temple hair/beard against those frames, rather than against generated guides. Keep the present verdict rejected until that comparison is possible.

findings.finding: Both wrists have an abrupt pinched cuff/ring and different geometry/skin treatment between forearm and the attached small hand. The joins remain visible at ordinary full-body render size.
findings.correction: Use a continuous forearm-to-wrist-to-hand taper and matched skin roughness/color/normal treatment. Recheck Idle and actual TakePizza from both sides.

findings.finding: Rear hair contains repeated dark perforation/groove patterns, and the shoulder has a conspicuous flat gray texture patch with an angular lower boundary.
findings.correction: Fill/remesh the hair cavities into a coherent scalp/hair surface, then rebake the shoulder/collar texture across the repaired seam.

entries.scope: isolated exact-GLB offline visual review; not actual story-scene approval

findings.finding: A tall featureless dark-brown neck cylinder is plainly visible beneath the beard. A straight dark shelf at the head base and skin/cloth discontinuity at the shoulder make the head look detached. This is not just lighting.
findings.correction: Replace the cylinder-like connector with anatomically shaped neck/trapezius/collarbone geometry, seamlessly welded/blended to the actual jaw and shirt neckline; rebake continuous skin/cloth materials and normals. Do not hide it solely by camera placement.

findings.finding: The swept top and beard point toward the correct character, but the back/sides contain rows of deep dark holes and comb-like vertical grooves, unlike the continuous layered hair in the official poster.
findings.correction: Repair rear/side hair geometry and rebake its texture/normal map with coherent swept layers. Keep natural nape silhouette without repeated cavities.

findings.finding: The forearm/hand boundaries have abrupt cuffs and color/shape changes, and there is a large hard-edged patch on the upper shoulder.
findings.correction: Blend/weld the wrist transition and fix skin material continuity; rebake the upper shoulder so the shirt surface has plausible folds and no seam-shaped flat patch.

handoffNotes: Both frontal handoff images show palms below the prop and approximately horizontal forearms; the numerical catch-point proof supports marker contact only.
Odela three-quarter handoff shows an apparent V/bend in the orange prop. Verify a rigid production carton in the real engine; do not treat this offline prop presentation as accepted.
The supplied body/hand pictures are Blender offline renders. A fresh production Three.js scene/camera/material review and continuous handoff remains required after the blocking art fixes.
unperformedChecks: No actual story scene or player camera was operated by this reviewer.
No continuous Walk/Dance/Read motion was visually inspected; seven still renders per candidate cannot establish gait or deformation quality.
No independent numerical contact test was rerun; the producer supplied contact proof was read and kept separate from visual approval.
filePolicy: Review notes only. Existing assets/approvals/production registries unchanged.
